text: This staff report is a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is requesting approval to prohibit parking at all times on the south side of Roehampton Avenue, from a point 43 metres east of Redpath Avenue to a point 32 metres further east, and from Mount Pleasant Road to a point 35 metres west. The proposed regulation will address concerns from residents of No. 199 Roehampton Avenue with regards to parked vehicles obstructing and reduced sightlines at their driveway access, and will correct the discrepancies between the parking regulation by-laws and the on-street posted parking regulations on the south side of Roehampton Avenue between Redpath Avenue and Mount Pleasant Road.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Amended the existing parking prohibition in effect from 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Saturday, on the south side of Roehampton Avenue, between a point 30.5 metres east of Redpath Avenue and Mount Pleasant Road, to be in effect from a point 15 metres east of Redpath Avenue to a point 28 metres further east and from a point 75 metres east of Redpath Avenue to a point 100 metres further east. 2. Authorized Recommendation 1 above to remain in effect after the completion of the construction project at No. 151 Roehampton Avenue (Item TE22.52 adopted at the February 22, 2017 Toronto and East York Community Council meeting). 3. Prohibited parking at all times on the south side of Roehampton Avenue from a point 43 metres east of Redpath Avenue to a point 32 metres further east and from Mount Pleasant Road to a point 35 metres west.
